description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which provides parsing and formatting functionalities for email addresses, including extracting names, hosts, and users from email address strings.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A class representing an email address, with methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting components.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Mail::Address module.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Internal method to extract a person's name from a comment or phrase.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Internal method to tokenize an email address string into components.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Internal method to find the next token of interest in tokenized address.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Internal method to create a new Mail::Address object from parsed components.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Mail::Address object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an email address string into a Mail::Address object.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Getter/setter for the phrase component of the address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Internal method to set or get a component value.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the person's name from the address components.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.
